titles.title: RGΦ: Exact rational radix–Möbius dynamics research compendium

resourceType.resourceType: Research software and exact mathematical evidence compendium

descriptions.description: Exact mathematical and computational research compendium for a noncommutative rational semigroup generated by an integer-radix transformation and a Möbius-conjugate branch. Includes a manuscript on robust nonnested extremal targets, finite modular-trap evidence, exact-arithmetic software, validation targets, and reproducibility metadata.
